semantics.identity_rule: Each closure snapshot has explicit identity.
semantics.source_rule: Exact accepted canonical source-set/registry snapshot is referenced.
semantics.members_rule: All in-scope canonical/component/domain/module identities are enumerated.
semantics.projection_rule: Snapshot is derived evidence and not source-of-truth.
semantics.reproducibility_rule: Equivalent accepted source snapshot yields semantically equivalent closure snapshot.

invariants.rule: Machine-significant identity, type, relation, state and meaning are explicit and never inferred solely from display text, path, layout, file order, timestamp or implementation accident.
Resolved, projected, indexed, cached, formatted or derived representations never become source-of-truth or authority merely because they are convenient or available.

references.purpose: Closure snapshot builds on exact canonical registry snapshot.
